units.source_text: 因为是微行，他的车马很简陋，也没有教人在前面开道，

en.t: Because he was traveling incognito, his carriage and horses were very plain, and he had not ordered anyone to clear the way ahead,

units.source_text: 他心想：“反正也没人知道我是谁。”

en.t: He thought to himself, "After all, no one knows who I am."

units.source_text: 就很自在。

en.t: So he felt quite at ease.

units.source_text: 他坐在车中望去，看见那人家的门也是薄板编成的，正敞开着。

en.t: Looking out from inside the carriage, he saw that the gate of that house too was woven of thin boards and stood wide open.

units.source_text: 室内很浅，是极简陋的住房。

en.t: The interior was shallow and the dwelling extremely crude.

units.source_text: 他觉得很可怜，想起古人“人生到处即为家”[\[5\]](#part1333.html#m5)之句。

en.t: He felt pity and recalled the old saying, "Wherever one goes in life becomes one's home"[\[5\]](#part1333.html#m5).

units.source_text: 又想：玉楼金屋，还不是一样的么？

en.t: Then he thought: Are jeweled towers and golden houses not the same in the end?

units.source_text: 这里的板垣旁边长着的蔓草，青葱可爱。

en.t: The vines growing beside the plank fence here were fresh green and lovely.

units.source_text: 草中开着许多白花，孤芳自赏地露出笑颜。

en.t: Many white flowers bloomed among the grass, showing their smiling faces as if admiring their own solitary beauty.

units.source_text: 源氏公子独自吟道：“花不知名分外娇！”

en.t: Prince Genji murmured to himself, "A flower whose name I do not know is lovelier still!"

units.source_text: 随从禀告：“这里开着的白花，名叫夕颜[\[6\]](#part1333.html#m6)。

en.t: An attendant reported, "The white flowers blooming here are called evening faces[\[6\]](#part1333.html#m6).

units.source_text: 这花的名字像人的名字。

en.t: The name of this flower sounds like a person's name.

units.source_text: 这种花都是开在这些肮脏的墙根的。”

en.t: This kind of flower always blooms at the base of such filthy walls."

units.source_text: 这一带的确都是些简陋的小屋，破破烂烂，东歪西倒，不堪入目。

en.t: This whole area was indeed full of crude little huts, shabby and broken, leaning this way and that, painful to look at.

units.source_text: 这种花就开在这些屋子旁边。

en.t: These flowers were blooming right beside those houses.

units.source_text: 源氏公子说：“可怜啊！

en.t: Prince Genji said, "How pitiful!

units.source_text: 这是薄命花。

en.t: This is an ill-fated flower.

units.source_text: 给我摘一朵来吧！”

en.t: Pick one for me!"

units.source_text: 随从便走进这开着的门内去，摘了一朵花。

en.t: The attendant then went through the open gate and picked a flower.

units.source_text: 不意里面一扇雅致的拉门里走出一个身穿黄色生绢长裙的女童来，向随从招手。

en.t: Unexpectedly, from behind an elegant sliding door inside, a little girl wearing a long skirt of yellow raw silk came out and beckoned to the attendant.

units.source_text: 她手里拿着一把香气扑鼻的白纸扇，说道：“请放在这上面献上去吧。

en.t: Holding a fragrant white paper fan in her hand, she said, "Please place it on this and present it to him.

units.source_text: 因为这花的枝条很软弱，不好用手拿的。”

en.t: The stem of this flower is very delicate, so it is not good to hold it by hand."

units.source_text: 就把扇子交给他。

en.t: Then she handed him the fan.

units.source_text: 正好这时候惟光出来开大门，随从就把盛着花的扇子交给惟光，由他献给源氏公子。

en.t: Just then Koremitsu came out to open the main gate, so the attendant gave the fan with the flower on it to Koremitsu, who presented it to Prince Genji.

units.source_text: 惟光惶恐地说：“钥匙放在什么地方，一时忘记了。

en.t: Koremitsu said in alarm, "I forgot for a moment where I had put the key.

units.source_text: 到现在才来开门，真是太失礼了。

en.t: To come and open the gate only now is truly inexcusable.

units.source_text: 这里虽然没有不识高低的人，但有劳公子在这杂乱的街上等候，实在……”

en.t: Although there is no one here who fails to know his place, to have made Your Grace wait in this disorderly street is really..."

units.source_text: 便教人把车子赶进门去，源氏公子下车，走进室内。

en.t: He then had someone drive the carriage through the gate; Prince Genji got down from it and went inside.
